This directory contains an excerpt copied VERBATIM from the official Spec Kit
template, pinned to a fixed upstream commit so tests never need network access.

Source: https://github.com/github/spec-kit
Commit: 0cc9a6a1159471a3108b9bad718ba17006dd6039 (tag v1.0.8)
File:   templates/spec-template.md (lines 1, 3, and the User Story 1 / User Story 2
        blocks including their `**Acceptance Scenarios**:` labels)

Why pinned: github/spec-kit may change its templates at any time; these tests
guard specripple's compatibility with the official format as of v1.0.8. If the
upstream template changes materially, re-pin to a new commit and update the
importer + tests deliberately.
